title: Catalana Kissed Ham and Turkey Empanadas
description: A fusion of Spanish and Mexican flavors, these empanadas feature ham and turkey, kissed by a sweet caramelized crema.
instructions: Roll out the Galician Kissed Pastry Dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a bowl, mix together the ham, turkey, crema, salt, black pepper, turmeric, garlic powder, and cumin.
Place a spoonful of the ham-turkey mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water and fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little crema and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
